children: Afya and Yduqs Participações have struck a deal to merge, bringing together two Brazilian higher-education platforms.

Afya is a medical-education group, offering undergraduate schooling for medical students and continued education for working professionals. Yduqs is an educational-technology and services group, offering a diverse portfolio of institutions.
Under the terms of the merger, Afya will merge into Yduqs, which will continue as the surviving entity and become the holding company for the combined group.
Afya's Class A and Class B common shares will be cancelled and converted into the right to receive newly issued common shares of the combined company.

Afya shareholders will own 69% of the combined company following the deal's close, which is subject to certain conditions including both shareholder and antitrust approval. Yduqs shareholders will own the remaining 31%.
